intro: Each engagement starts with an in-home walkthrough. Scope, pace and pricing set together.

items.name: The Edit
items.summary: Guided decluttering. Keep, release, donate. Room by room, without overwhelm.
items.details: A focused session to reduce what a space holds. Items sorted together into keep, donate, sell and release. Donations dropped off. Space left ready for organizing.

items.name: The Arrange
items.summary: Systems designed for how you live. Closets, pantries, kitchens, studios, garages.
items.details: Storage systems built around daily habits. Zones defined, containers chosen, everything labeled. Built to hold up after we leave.

items.name: The Reset
items.summary: Full edit and arrange, finished with a botanical clean. A space returned whole.
items.details: The complete service. Declutter, organize, then clean every surface with Sun & Sage Botanicals. Finishing bottle left behind.

items.name: The Seasonal
items.summary: Recurring visits each season. Systems maintained, spaces refreshed, order kept.
items.details: Quarterly visits to keep systems working. Seasonal wardrobe swaps, pantry refreshes, light botanical clean.
